source.notes: arch-042 (A8 transition breadth). RWKV-7: S_t = Diag(exp w_t)·S_{t-1} + (a_tᵀS_{t-1})⊗b_t + v_t⊗k_t, o_t = (scale·r_t)ᵀ·S_t (read after update).
